textSegments: Hydro GT PRO | Power Supplies (PSU) | FSP
Complies with ATX12V V2.5 & EPS12V V2.92
The LLC topology  allows for zero voltage switching of the main switches thereby dramatically lowering switching losses and boosting efficiency.
450V, 105°C Japanese main capacitors have premium quality, protecting your equipment from the infamous capacitor leakage problem and also increasing the life-span of your equipment
ECO Switch, Quieter and Longer Lasting Fan

The Hydro GT PRO series offers an Eco Switch that allows the PSU to operate quieter uses up less power consumption. When the power supply is equal to or less than 30% load, the power supply enters a silent state and the fan is turned off.
The Hydro GT PRO series comes with FDB fan and an intelligent 0dBA function to reduce noise and has a longer lasting life span.
Hydro GT PRO series is designed semi-modular that not just saves user’s time for installation, but also provides your system a neat and tidy look for cable management.
Black Flat Cable with Multiple EPS12V Connectors
Dual CPU power connectors support modern motherboards and deliver stable power to your CPU, the all black coating flat cables gives Hydro GT PRO series a stylish and quality look.
Hydro GT PRO series is a power supply with 80 PLUS® Gold Certification that guarantees to operate at a minimum of 90% efficiency at 50% load of PSU rated power and reduces electricity cost.
